airspaceFile.title: Airspace file
airspaceFile.summary: {airspaces, plural, one {# airspace} other {# airspaces}} and {notams, plural, one {# NOTAM} other {# NOTAMs}} selected, bundled into one OpenAir {version} file readable by XCTrack, XCSoar, SeeYou and more.
airspaceFile.openAreasV21: {count, plural, one {# dynamic open area} other {# dynamic open areas}}: while active, overlapping zones are exported with the open volume cut out, time-tagged per activation window.
airspaceFile.openAreasV1: {count, plural, one {# dynamic open area} other {# dynamic open areas}}: v1 cannot carry activation hours, so the area counts as open for the whole file. It is not written as a zone, only cut out of every zone it overlaps.

v21.label: OpenAir v2.1 (recommended)
v21.hint: Carries activation hours (AA), airspace type, identifiers and radio frequencies. A dynamic open area only opens the sky during its own windows. Read by XCTrack, XCSoar, SeeYou and openAIP.

v1.label: OpenAir v1 (legacy)
v1.hint: Core records only: the widest instrument support, but no activation hours, so every zone is always active. A dynamic open area is therefore left out of the file entirely and simply cut out of the airspaces it overlaps, because open sky needs no zone.
